existing_diagram_checks.map_orientation_index_sign_checks: No existing diagrams were present in the assigned 88 items; there were therefore no diagram maps, orientations, indices, or signs to validate.

diagram_candidates.claim: The CYK table is triangular with interval entries T[i,l]; for l>=2, a split k combines B in T[i,k] and C in T[i+k,l-k] under A->BC.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The index shifts and split relation are precise but visually dense; a small worked span triangle can expose off-by-one indexing and the whole-word top cell.
diagram_candidates.suggested_content: Input positions a_1,...,a_n along the base; span cell T[i,l] covering a_i...a_{i+l-1}; one parent cell split at k into T[i,k] and T[i+k,l-k], labelled A->BC; top cell T[1,n].
diagram_candidates.math_check: Confirm the two child spans are adjacent, disjoint, and cover the parent interval, including k=1 and k=l-1.

diagram_candidates.claim: A (T+1)x(T+1) array has rows encoding one NTM branch; each row has one state-tagged tape symbol, and halting rows may repeat.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The item directly defines an array-shaped mathematical object and stresses that it encodes one branch rather than the full tree.
diagram_candidates.suggested_content: A time-by-tape grid with rows 0,...,T and columns 0,...,T; initial configuration in row 0; one uniquely marked state/head symbol per row; a local legal transition between consecutive rows; repeated terminal row padding; show one branch only.
diagram_candidates.math_check: Keep time on rows and tape position on columns, ensure the head marker is unique per row, and do not depict the entire nondeterministic computation tree as a single tableau.

diagram_candidates.claim: The folded simulation stores the two-way origin at one-way cell 0 and, for each n>=1, stores the ordered pair of symbols at +n and -n; a marker records the simulated head.
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The sign/index mapping and four crossings at the origin are easy to reverse; a map would make the exact coordinate convention visible.
diagram_candidates.suggested_content: A two-way tape with indices ...,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,... mapped to one-way cells 2,1,0,1,2,... where each positive one-way cell stores the ordered pair (+n,-n); mark the head component; show transitions through 0.
diagram_candidates.math_check: The source uses ordered pair (+n,-n): verify left/right movement on each side maps to movement toward/away from the origin with the stated sign, and the four moves crossing the origin map between cells 0 and 1.

scope_and_limitations: Read-only local review of the frozen assignment sources, frozen snapshots, captured HTML, screenshot metadata, and original PNG tiles.
No HTTP requests or live website review; no item, application, tool, or publication-status edits.
Optional typography observations are separated from confirmed content-rendering defects.

Mathematical diagram review was limited to whether source claims warrant diagrams and whether their proposed maps can be specified; no existing diagrams were present for independent diagram validation.
